text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A number of Mozambique's industralised cashew-shelling factories may have to close this year because of a shortage of unshelled nuts. The government has decreased its tax protection for the cashew industry and producers are selling to traders who export unshelled nuts to India for manual shelling.

- The director of Mozambique's National Hydrocarbons company, Issufo Abdala, has expressed optimism that oil reserves will be found by some of the foreign companies currently prospecting in Mozambique.
